name: Neovim

1.how: nvim --listen /run/user/$UID/nvim-<name>.sock, then nvim --server <sock> --remote <file> | --remote-send <keys> | --remote-expr <expr>; full msgpack-RPC API (nvim_buf_get_lines, nvim_command…) over the same socket
1.notes: Everything the editor can do, typed. Omarchy's LazyVim setup works unchanged.

1.how: nvim +<line> <file> | -c <cmd> | --headless -c <cmd> -c q (batch edits with no UI)

quirks: Inside a maus term session, nvim's screen is also readable as text via tmux; prefer the socket for edits.
